summary: Southern California Gas Co., an indirect subsidiary of Sempra, filed an 8-K to report the closing of a registered public offering of $650 million in 5.900% First Mortgage Bonds due 2056. The bonds were sold at 98.661% of par, under a Form S-3 shelf registration. Proceeds net of underwriting discount but before ~$1.4M in other expenses were received. The bonds mature June 1, 2056, pay semiannual interest starting December 1, 2026, and are callable at the company's option. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. There are no risk-arb or event-driven angles to monitor.
